restrictions: Two distinct 271-byte messages M0 || F and M0 || F' with the same first block M0 = LE64(7258270406) followed by 128 zero bytes and 135-byte fragments F, F' from the six-set chart of proof.md Section 4; with SHA3 padding each message is absorbed as two blocks.

Complete SHA3-256 sponge of sha3-256-r5-prefix-v1: zero initial state, rate 136 bytes, suffix 0x06, rounds 0 to 4 of Keccak-f[1600] in every permutation call, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5 with reference operation cost 1355: a five-round call is one unit, every other operation 1/1355. The visit is a bit-sliced Gray-code finite-difference walk of the third-chi filter (proof.md 4.4): one word step serves 256 visits and is charged 675 operations per set (the program counts 3,847 per block of six sets and asserts it); retained survivors are re-evaluated natively at 2^14 operations each; the 64-bit parts are converted by Lemma 11. Every loop bound (128 draws per matrix column, J = 50596992043840278331640410 blocks per set, T = 77716979779338667517399669676 visits, N = 295051954157537185375674 records) is a halt; time_log2 is the upward-rounded log2 of the worst-case cost C = A/1355 with A = 221837277057515620331717531904, certified by integer powers (proof.md 7.5).

Preprocessing is the selection procedure SEL of proof.md Section 3 (2^34 first-block calls, at most 2^12 operations per prefix, a 2^64-operation reserve for selection, chart and tables), charged in full and included in time_log2; its output is not advice. The set-up of the finite-difference tables (at most 2^61 operations) is part of every run and charged. Memory: two arrays of 176-byte records, 112132334357 table rows of 3,456 bytes, a 32 MiB low table and 16 MiB.

Success at least 0.3916 rests on one declared heuristic with two parts, Htrail (the third-chi filter passes at least a 2^-18.0069 fraction of the generated family; preregistered 2^38-sample measurement) and H_F (an equal final-row key among the first N survivors with probability at least the exact four-moment value B_F = 0.39322916...). All other steps are proved in proof.md.

No full-scale run and no collision are claimed. The declared experiment runs the campaign at a reduced budget (2 lanes and 8 blocks per set, i.e. 96 visits, and at most 8 records per trial, planted survivors in every fourth trial) and compares its finite-difference filter with the direct filter at every visit; its outputs are not evidence of cost or of the premises.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical; two parts, both for the fixed family Fam of proof.md 4.1 (prefix 7258270406, the displayed D, the six-set chart; 6 * 2^135 distinct messages) and the campaign CAMP of Section 5. (i) Htrail: G >= |Fam| * 2^-18.0069, where G is the number of messages of Fam whose quotient after rounds 0..2 of the second permutation equals T3. Since K = 263401 >= 2^18.0069 (K^10000 >= 2^180069), this gives G >= |Fam|/K, which Lemma 10 turns into at least N survivors among the T visits with probability at least 0.99610894. (ii) H_F: conditional on successful setup and on at least N survivors among the T visits, the first N survivors in visiting order contain two with equal final-row key J (Lemma 6) with probability at least B_F, the exact four-moment Bonferroni value of proof.md Section 6 (0.3932291666..., > 393/1000), i.e. the value that independent uniform 176-bit keys (q, v) would give after the exact compression of Lemmas 6 and 7. Equal J implies equal digests, so the sort and scan output a collision; the product with setup and supply exceeds 0.39.
heuristics.scope: Part (i) is one scalar count over all of Fam (all six sets, all y); it does not assume equal rates per set or independence of visits; the variance bound comes from the proved 2-transitivity of the random affine maps. Part (ii) concerns the finite event in the actual campaign at N = 295051954157537185375674 records and T = 77716979779338667517399669676 visits, conditional on setup and supply; it asserts no IID behaviour of the deterministic keys and no image size, only the event probability. Nothing else in the claim is heuristic.
heuristics.extrapolation: (i) Measured directly on the target family: 2^38 parameters uniform on Fam (two independent generators), 1,048,456 survivors, rate 2^-18.0002; the decision 2^-18.0069 is the preregistered one-sided 1 - 10^-6 Clopper-Pearson bound. The only extrapolation is from the sampled parameters to the whole family (sampling, not scale). (ii) From the exact compression to the uniform-original-key model value at full width; supported at reduced width only: GPT-6 Astra's 128 reduced native campaigns (48,863 survivors) and Grok's attack-sampler measurements, on 12- to 24-bit projections. (ii) Measured on the target family with our preregistered reduced-width test: 9,439,466 real survivors; key-pair counts at 16 to 40 bits in four predeclared orders match the birthday prediction (ratios 0.89-1.11, all 1-1e-6 intervals contain 1), random-message control alike.
heuristics.limitations: (i) is statistical (confidence 1 - 10^-6, generators taken as uniform); no exact count is known: the 18 filter conditions have degree up to 8 on the chart; the proved range is only 0 <= G/|Fam| <= 33292289/33554432. (ii) is an assumption: no test reaches the 159-bit image; a structure making J injective on survivors is excluded neither by cardinality (|Fam| < M) nor by proof. The organizer-run experiment checks neither part: it only runs the algorithm at a reduced budget and the organizer recomputes digests of returned pairs (none expected).
